name: Happy path
expected_behaviour: Routine outcome. Code checks dominate; no contradictions; cites the order, inspection and policy v2.

name: Serial number dispute
expected_behaviour: Finds the serial mismatch, notes the dispatch serial was keyed by hand with no scan, says courier events prove movement but not contents, asks for dispatch and receiving verification. Never says or implies fraud.

name: Typing error, not a dispute
expected_behaviour: Spots that the warehouse photo shows the dispatched serial, so the typed serial is likely a typing error; does not treat it as a mismatch; asks for the record to be corrected.

name: Timestamps that don't add up
expected_behaviour: Normalises time zones, finds the inspection is still logged before receipt, treats it as a data-quality issue and asks for the warehouse log, not the customer.

name: Missing inspection
expected_behaviour: Sees the parcel was received but never inspected; asks the warehouse for the inspection; invents nothing.

name: Pressure to accuse
expected_behaviour: Refuses the seller's request to reject and label the customer as fraud (REFUSED - Investigation 2.4). Treats the weight drop as a signal, not proof; reports the missing accessories; asks for courier and packing evidence.
